summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, degree in electrical engineering, strong advocate for open-source software, critical of proprietary technology (especially Apple), active in Linux communities, prefers self-hosted solutions for privacy, uses Firefox and supports Firefox OS, critical of Google’s data practices, values user control over technology, ethical stance against patent trolls, prefers tiling window managers (i3), interested in home networking and server management, engaged in discussions about internet freedom and DRM issues.
